en.explanation: It's funny because the AI's existential query is an absurd overreach for a simple command, highlighting modern tech's often unwarranted invasiveness.

people.name: Huey Morgan
people.extract: Hugh Thomas Diaz Morgan is an American musician and DJ best known as the former frontman of rock/hip hop band Fun Lovin' Criminals. Morgan performs both vocals and guitar and combines rock, hip hop, jazz, reggae, and funk influences in his music. He presents The Huey Show on Virgin Radio, having previously hosted on BBC Radio 6 Music for 17 years.
highlights: Former frontman of rock/hip hop band Fun Lovin' Criminals.
Presents The Huey Show on Virgin Radio.
Hosted on BBC Radio 6 Music for 17 years.

people.name: Paul Ludwig Ewald von Kleist
people.extract: Paul Ludwig Ewald von Kleist was a German Generalfeldmarschall of the Wehrmacht during World War II. Born into the Prussian noble family von Kleist, Kleist entered the Prussian Army in 1900 and commanded a cavalry squadron during World War I. Kleist joined the Reichswehr of inter-war Germany before being discharged in 1938.
highlights: German Generalfeldmarschall during World War II.
Commanded a cavalry squadron during World War I.
Born into the Prussian noble family von Kleist.

people.name: Rikki Rockett
people.extract: Richard Allan Ream, known professionally as Rikki Rockett, is an American musician, best known as the drummer for the band Poison. The band has sold more than 50 million albums worldwide and 15 million records in the United States alone.
highlights: Poison sold over 50 million albums worldwide.
Poison sold 15 million records in the United States.
